measurement: smaps sum at completed batch boundaries; TPS is output tokens / makespan

continuous_gpu.method: 4 concurrent requests, 2048 output tokens, 12 back-to-back rounds; native allocator sampled every 5 seconds in an identical diagnostic thread on both variants; no GC/trim or socket access from observer
continuous_gpu.analysis_window: skip first 60 seconds of load; stop 10 seconds before last response to exclude idle notification cleanup
